title: Distinct leaf rectangles are disjoint
statement: Let $p$ be a deterministic two-party communication protocol over input types $X$ and $Y$ producing values in $\alpha$, and let $R$ and $S$ be two of its leaf rectangles, that is, two of the input rectangles induced by the leaves of $p$ over $X \times Y$. If $R \neq S$, then $R$ and $S$ are disjoint as subsets of $X \times Y$.
hypotheses_covered: p is a deterministic communication protocol
R is a leaf rectangle of p
S is a leaf rectangle of p
replaced:
For any protocol $p$, if $R, S \in \texttt{leafRectangles}(p)$ and $R \neq S$, then $R$ and
$S$ are disjoint.
